September 2, 1971
2014-12-12T00:03:35+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-2-1971-54675

Attack on Dharmagarh BOP in September 2-3, 1971 Source: Shafiullah, KM Bir Uttam Major General. Muktijuddhe Bangladesh, Dhaka: Agami Prokashon, 1995: 194.

Mukti Bahini guerrillas attack Pak outpost at Gojaria on Narayanganj-Daudkandi. Three Pak troops are killed and one is held captive. Five rifles and 150 rounds of ammunitions are recovered.

A 45-member team of freedom fighters commence operation in Konagram and Bianibazar region. Three Razakars and a collaborator are killed in action.
